Bazel 9.4.0-dzbarsky4

This release backports remote repository contents cache (R2C2) fixes from dzbarsky/bazel master at d4985923d8 onto 9.4.0-dzbarsky3.

- Bazel can refetch evicted repository inputs used by query, mod, fetch, vendor, local actions, remote uploads, top-level outputs, and runfiles. If a verified copy is already on disk, Bazel can use it after eviction.
- Freshly uploaded repositories retain file digests. Cached repositories preserve POSIX symlink targets and handle dangling links, symlink chains, and links from a native repository into a cached repository. Bazel skips remote entries it cannot encode losslessly and refetches watched trees containing non-UTF-8 names.
- Repository cache lookup handles inline stdout, carriage returns in recorded inputs, missing repository mappings, and retargeted directory symlinks. The remote repository cache key changed to prevent reuse of entries with lossy path encodings.
- The release also includes fixes for repository copy destinations and executable permissions, Windows runfiles, shared downloads, and action rewinding when cached outputs disappear.
